title: Weekend Roll of the Valid-Through Date for Imaging and Procedure Authorization Extensions
content:
On an extended Advanced Imaging Prior Authorization or Outpatient Procedure Prior Authorization (Referrals & Prior Authorizations), the weekend roll of the added validity follows the day on which the valid-through date, moved forward by the added validity days counted before any weekend roll, would fall:

- a Saturday gives a weekend roll of 2 days;
- a Sunday gives a weekend roll of 1 day;
- any other day gives no weekend roll.

With the roll, the authorization runs through the following Monday. The weekend roll is added to the added validity days.

## Worked dates (hypothetical valid-through date of Friday 2026-04-10)

| Added validity before the roll | Would fall on | Weekend roll | Added validity days | New valid-through date |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 22 days | Saturday 2026-05-02 | 2 days | 24 | Monday 2026-05-04 |
| 23 days | Sunday 2026-05-03 | 1 day | 24 | Monday 2026-05-04 |
| 24 days | Monday 2026-05-04 | none | 24 | Monday 2026-05-04 |
